propositions: Projects cannot currently extend built-in code-review overlays (e.g. 'concurrency', 'performance') with custom trigger vocabulary; only standalone 'project.*' criteria are supported in routing.

The trigger consumption path (glob_triggered_overlays, content_triggered_overlays) must union project-supplied trigger_tokens and applies_to globs with committed overlay triggers without replacing them.

A new helper (project_trigger_extensions) must read project overlay entries for built-in ids and extract trigger_tokens (literal substring matches on diff lines) and applies_to globs, bypassing effective_routing to preserve additive semantics.
Malformed project trigger entries (non-list trigger_tokens, non-string tokens, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored at consumption, not raising errors.
New unit tests must verify token and glob union behavior, confirm backward compatibility when no project overlay is present, and validate the rejection of malformed inputs.
